note: v7: v6 lines that still hold, plus new lines for the approval sheets (BTC-backed credit because US stocks are closed).

lines.text: Your money is in stocks, but the shop wants dollars. So you sell first, and wait.
lines.say: Your money is in stocks, but the shop wants dollars. So you sell first, and wait.

lines.text: Noren lets a shop take stablecoins, stocks, or credit against your stocks. Live on NEAR.
lines.say: Noh-ren lets a shop take stablecoins, stocks, or credit against your stocks. Live on Near.

lines.text: Aubelle, a dress boutique, signs in to Noren Merchant with a NEAR wallet, and names the account that gets paid: shop dot noren.
lines.say: Oh-bell, a dress boutique, signs in to Noh-ren Merchant with a Near wallet, and names the account that gets paid: shop dot noh-ren.

lines.text: A first payment link, and an API key that's shown once.
lines.say: A first payment link, and an A P I key that's shown once.

lines.text: Riya shops at Aubelle. The Amélie gingham, size small, and checkout with Noren.
lines.say: Riya shops at Oh-bell. The Amelie gingham, size small, and checkout with Noh-ren.

lines.text: Four ways to pay, and stocks come first. She pays with Tesla, at a live Yahoo Finance price, signed by Noren and checked by the contract on NEAR.
lines.say: Four ways to pay, and stocks come first. She pays with Tesla, at a live Yahoo Finance price, signed by Noh-ren and checked by the contract on Near.

lines.text: Noren sells just enough Tesla, and Aubelle gets a hundred and forty-eight dollars in USDC. Final in seconds.
lines.say: Noh-ren sells just enough Tesla, and Oh-bell gets a hundred and forty-eight dollars in U S D C. Final in seconds.

lines.text: In the Noren app, she sees her dollars, her stocks and her credit, all read live from NEAR.
lines.say: In the Noh-ren app, she sees her dollars, her stocks and her credit, all read live from Near.

lines.text: Back at Aubelle, she picks the Juliette dress.
lines.say: Back at Oh-bell, she picks the Juliette dress.

lines.text: Aubelle sees every payment in one place: the stock sale, the credit payment, the first installment. All in USDC, all final on NEAR.
lines.say: Oh-bell sees every payment in one place: the stock sale, the credit payment, the first installment. All in U S D C, all final on Near.

lines.text: This time, she chooses Pay later.
lines.say: This time, she chooses Pay later.

lines.text: Now from a wallet with no NEAR at all. She pastes Aubelle's link and pays twelve dollars in USDC.
lines.say: Now from a wallet with no Near at all. She pastes Oh-bell's link and pays twelve dollars in U S D C.

lines.text: Final on NEAR, and the network fee is paid by Noren.
lines.say: Final on Near, and the network fee is paid by Noh-ren.

lines.text: On NEAR, Noren's relayer is the signer. Her payment rides inside, as a delegate action.
lines.say: On Near, Noh-ren's relayer is the signer. Her payment rides inside, as a delegate action.

lines.text: Now she pays Aubelle's twelve-dollar link in USDC, from her own wallet. Before anything is signed, the test wallet shows what she is approving: who gets paid, and who pays the gas. She approves.
lines.say: Now she pays Oh-bell's twelve-dollar link in U S D C, from her own wallet. Before anything is signed, the test wallet shows what she is approving: who gets paid, and who pays the gas. She approves.

lines.text: The explorer confirms it: success.
lines.say: The explorer confirms it: success.

lines.text: No Near needed for gas. The wallet says it plainly: the relayer pays the gas. She approves.
lines.say: No Near needed for gas. The wallet says it plainly: the relayer pays the gas. She approves.

lines.text: But she'd rather keep her coins. Stocks are closed today, so she locks test bitcoin as collateral. The wallet shows the lock, and she approves.
lines.say: But she'd rather keep her coins. Stocks are closed today, so she locks test bitcoin as collateral. The wallet shows the lock, and she approves.

lines.text: Her credit line opens at about two hundred and fifty-eight dollars.
lines.say: Her credit line opens at about two hundred and fifty-eight dollars.

lines.text: The wallet shows a borrow of a hundred and fifty-eight dollars, paid straight to Aubelle. She approves.
lines.say: The wallet shows a borrow of a hundred and fifty-eight dollars, paid straight to Oh-bell. She approves.

lines.text: Aubelle is paid in full from her credit line, and her bitcoin stays hers.
lines.say: Oh-bell is paid in full from her credit line, and her bitcoin stays hers.

lines.text: Her next order, the Rosalie knit, is a hundred and seventy-eight dollars. She splits it in three. The wallet shows the schedule, and she approves.
lines.say: Her next order, the Rosalie knit, is a hundred and seventy-eight dollars. She splits it in three. The wallet shows the schedule, and she approves.

lines.text: The first draw pays Aubelle a third today, approved the same way. The other two are due in thirty and sixty days.
lines.say: The first draw pays Oh-bell a third today, approved the same way. The other two are due in thirty and sixty days.

lines.text: When she's ready, she repays from the app, with a little interest. She approves, the debt goes to zero, and her bitcoin is free again.
lines.say: When she's ready, she repays from the app, with a little interest. She approves, the debt goes to zero, and her bitcoin is free again.

lines.text: Noren. Keep your coins, and still buy the thing.
lines.say: Noh-ren. Keep your coins, and still buy the thing.
